name: Furry Weekend Atlanta
blurb: One of the world's largest furry conventions, held each May across a block of downtown Atlanta hotels.

editions.venue: Marriott Marquis Atlanta & downtown Atlanta hotel block
editions.evidence: Homepage: 'May 6th-9th, 2027 REGISTRATION IS OPEN!'; hotels page: 'FWA 2027 Hotels' listing Marriott Marquis, Hyatt Regency, Hilton, Courtland Grand and Westin Atlanta

notes: The site is a freshly rebuilt Astro site; nav items About/Events and the guests-of-honor page (/dealers-and-artists/guests-of-honor/, found via WebSearch) all 404 live, so guestsPage falls back to the homepage. A WebSearch found that 'Faru of Big Lion's Den' has been announced as the 2027 Guest of Honor under a 'Grand Prix' theme (matching the homepage's racing-themed hero art), but with no working guest page to read or a sourceable photo, guests is marked 'unavailable' rather than guessed from the search snippet alone. The hotels page lists FWA's 2027 downtown-Atlanta hotel block but does not label a single headquarters hotel; the first-listed (Marriott Marquis Atlanta) is used as venue. No organizer legal name is stated on the site (described only as a 'community-driven, volunteer-led organization').
